scope_rule: The official report lists a player only when a designation or practice limitation applies. This snapshot keeps every listed player whose game status is Out, Doubtful or Questionable, plus every player listed with no game status but a DNP or Limited practice mark (those carry the availability information the Monday slate has to offer: its status report is not due until Saturday). Players published as a full participant with no designation carry no information and are not copied.
